explication: CockroachDB is a distributed SQL database: clients submit SQL, which is executed through transactional coordination and a strongly consistent, replicated key-value storage layer. The repository also supports data lifecycle workflows including backup and restore, changefeeds, and cross-cluster replication, with cloud storage integrations and job tracking. The README establishes the product workflow and core capabilities; sampled source confirms selected transaction, Raft, storage, changefeed, cloud-storage, replication, and job behavior. Other subsystem links use documented capabilities and tree paths, not inspected implementation details.
